ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 22 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

The Gospel passages (Matthew 10 and 16) are translated from Tolstoy's Russian, keeping «душа» (dusha, 'soul') with his gloss «(жизнь)» (zhizn', 'life'); «благо» (blago) is 'the good' and «добро» (dobro) 'good', and «личность» (lichnost') is 'personality'. The Carlyle thought, which the website draft had left unattributed, now carries its printed attribution «Карлейл» (Karleyl, 'Carlyle'); «Люси Малори» (Lyusi Malori) is Lucy Mallory.

Source observation: [21–22] The Carlyle passage and its attribution are not set as a quotation (no «>»), unlike the other attributed readings, and the name is spelled «Карлейл» rather than the usual «Карлейль»; reproduced as printed (unquoted).
